parameters.name: EventCycleStatus
parameters.description:
The lifecycle status of the system event. EventCycleStatus takes effect only when InstanceEventCycleStatus.N is not specified. Valid values: 

- Scheduled: The event is waiting to be executed.
- Avoided: The event has been avoided.
- Executing: The event is being executed.
- Executed: The event has been executed.
- Canceled: The event has been canceled.
- Failed: The event failed to be executed.
- Inquiring: The event is being inquired.

parameters.name: EventId
parameters.description: One or more system event IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100. Specify multiple values in a repeated list format.

parameters.name: EventPublishTime.End
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query the publish time of system events. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: EventPublishTime.Start
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query the publish time of system events. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The type of the system event. EventType takes effect only when InstanceEventType.N is not specified. Valid values: 

- SystemMaintenance.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to system maintenance.
- SystemMaintenance.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to system maintenance.
- SystemFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to a system error.
- SystemFailure.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to a system error.
- SystemFailure.Delete: The instance is released due to an instance creation failure.
- InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error.
- InstanceExpiration.Stop: The instance is stopped due to subscription expiration.
- InstanceExpiration.Delete: The instance is released due to subscription expiration.
- AccountUnbalanced.Stop: The pay-as-you-go instance is stopped due to an overdue payment.
- AccountUnbalanced.Delete: The pay-as-you-go instance is released due to an overdue payment.

> For more information about event types, see [System event overview](~~66574~~). The value of this parameter can only be an instance system event, not a disk system event.

parameters.name: ImpactLevel
parameters.description: > This parameter is not yet available for use.

parameters.name: InstanceEventCycleStatus
parameters.description:
One or more lifecycle statuses of system events. Valid values of N: 1 to 7. Specify multiple values in a repeated list format. Valid values:

- Scheduled: The event is waiting to be executed.
- Avoided: The event has been avoided.
- Executing: The event is being executed.
- Executed: The event has been executed.
- Canceled: The event has been canceled.
- Failed: The event failed to be executed.
- Inquiring: The event is being inquired.

parameters.name: InstanceEventType
parameters.description:
One or more types of system events. Valid values of N: 1 to 30. Specify multiple values in a repeated list format. Valid values:

- SystemMaintenance.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to system maintenance.
- SystemMaintenance.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to system maintenance.
- SystemFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to a system error.
- SystemFailure.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to a system error.
- SystemFailure.Delete: The instance is released due to an instance creation failure.
- InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error.
- InstanceExpiration.Stop: The instance is stopped due to subscription expiration.
- InstanceExpiration.Delete: The instance is released due to subscription expiration.
- AccountUnbalanced.Stop: The pay-as-you-go instance is stopped due to an overdue payment.
- AccountUnbalanced.Delete: The pay-as-you-go instance is released due to an overdue payment.

> For more information about event types, see [System event overview](~~66574~~). The value of this parameter can only be an instance system event, not a disk system event.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. If you do not specify an instance ID, the system events of all instances in the specified region are queried.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paging query. Valid values: 10 to 100.

Default value:

* When the settings value is greater than 0 but less than 10, the default value is 10.
* When the settings value is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: NotBefore.End
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query the scheduled execution time of system events. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: NotBefore.Start
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query the scheduled execution time of system events. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter will be deprecated. Use MaxResults and NextToken for pagination queries.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter will be deprecated. Use MaxResults and NextToken for pagination queries.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
One or more resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100. Specify multiple values in a repeated list format. Valid values:

- When `ResourceType=instance`, the resource ID is the ECS instance ID.
- When `ResourceType=ddh`, the resource ID is the dedicated host ID.
- When `ResourceType=managedhost`, the resource ID is the physical machine ID in an intelligent fully managed resource pool.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system events of all resources of the specified resource type (`ResourceType`) in the specified region (`RegionId`) are queried.

> Use `ResourceId.N` to specify one or more resource IDs. If you specify both `ResourceId.N` and `InstanceId`, `ResourceId.N` takes precedence by default.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- instance: ECS instance.
- ddh: dedicated host.
- managedhost: physical machine in an intelligent fully managed resource pool.

Default value: instance.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags supported by system events.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the resource.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the resource.
